title: Missions
definition: Missions is the Church's work of carrying the Gospel across cultures, regions, and nations for the glory of Christ.
summary: God's saving purpose reaches the nations. The Church participates through prayer, sending, going, giving, and proclaiming Christ.
christFocus: Christ sends His people to bear witness to Him among all nations.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's saving purpose reaches the nations. The Church participates through prayer, sending, going, giving, and proclaiming Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
